verdict.rationale: The SDK's client library is published in a public first-party GitHub repository (aws/amazon-chime-sdk-js) that contains the source, a test suite, and demo apps, so the source is readable. No evidence in the pack states which license covers it, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, confirmation of source availability for components beyond the JS client, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
